Named for the hip downtown New York neighborhood, the Nolita Wristlet 24 features a convertible chain strap that allows you to carry it as a clutch or top handle. An ideal grab-and-go style, it's crafted of polished pebble leather embellished with floral rivets.

The gently-worn bag has been expertly cleaned, conditioned and lovingly restored by the talented craftspeople at our Coach Repair Workshop. Extending the life of our bags and keeping them out of a landfill is all part of our commitment to rethinking and reducing our impact on the planet. Wear it, love it, pass it on.
